intent: Individually teach manager after discussion without causal inference, secretary sending without assumed reading, police officer as person, every room empty without total-safety inference, soldier helping after flood without invented delivery, guard checking tickets at gate, all these trees bounded scope, coach reminder after running without assumed completion.
picturePurpose: Six original changing coded diagrams teach timing, person/place, universal scope and object/location; exact text and bounds stay code-owned.

workshop.title: 谁做了什么，条件不能丢
workshop.instruction: 改先后、换对象、查范围；职业名称要和原句动作一起读。

transfer.passage:
三条新信息
讨论后，班长调整了座位安排。管理员确认每扇窗都关好了。我们的访客知道这些建筑的名称。
词语提示：monitor 班长；seating plan 座位安排；caretaker 管理员；building 建筑。

options.text: The monitor changed the seating plan before our discussion. The caretaker checked that every window was closed. Our visitor knows the names of all these buildings.
The monitor changed the seating plan after our discussion. The caretaker checked that only one window was closed. Our visitor knows the names of all these buildings.
The monitor changed the seating plan after our discussion. The caretaker checked that every window was closed. Our visitor knows the names of all buildings in the world.
The monitor changed the seating plan after our discussion. The caretaker checked that every window was closed. Our visitor knows the names of all these buildings.

answer.display: The monitor changed the seating plan after our discussion. The caretaker checked that every window was closed. Our visitor knows the names of all these buildings.

explanation.strategy: 先核对after的先后，再核对every和all these的范围。
